intro.title: How to Use God Life AI
intro.content1: God Life AI is a service where you design and record your day through conversations with an AI coach.
intro.content2: No complex setup needed. Just talk to the AI every day.
intro.content3: Wake up → Talk to AI → Today's plan auto-organized
intro.content4: After work → Talk to AI → Daily record auto-organized
intro.content5: Need to note something → Quick memo → AI saves it with tags
intro.content6: That's all there is to it.
intro.content7: Tap the chat button at the bottom right to get started.
intro.content8: The next pages will show you practical tips for each feature.

aiCoach.title: How to Use AI Coach
aiCoach.subtitle: Manage everything through conversation
aiCoach.description:
Tap the chat button at the bottom right and you'll see 3 options:

[Plan] Tap this in the morning
[Report] Tap this in the evening
[Memo] Tap this anytime

━━ Case 1: Morning Planning ━━

(Tap Plan)
AI: "Good morning! Yesterday you set 'prepare presentation' as a goal — how did it go?"
You: "Got about halfway through"
AI: "Hey, halfway is solid progress! Want to finish it today?"
You: "Yeah, I'll wrap it up today"
AI: "Got it! Should I save 'finish presentation' as today's goal?"
You: "Yes"
→ Automatically saved to Destiny Navigator

━━ Case 2: Evening Report ━━

(Tap Report)
AI: "Today's goal was 'finish presentation' — how did it go?"
You: "Done! My manager said it was great"
AI: "That's awesome! Feels good to get praise, right? Want me to save that as something you're grateful for today?"
You: "Sure"
→ Automatically saved to Self Epistle's gratitude section
AI: "Did you spend any money today?"
You: "Lunch burrito $12, coffee $6"
→ Automatically saved to Money Flow

━━ Case 3: Quick Memo ━━

(Tap Memo)
You: "Report due by next Friday"
AI: "Should I save it like this? 'Report due by next Friday' #work #todo"
You: "Yes"
→ Auto-saved with timestamp and tags, AI will bring it up during your evening review

Bottom line: Just talk. The AI handles the rest.
aiCoach.source: Conversational AI coaching system — manage all modules automatically through chat

destiny.title: Destiny Navigator
destiny.subtitle: Design your life with AI
destiny.description:
Destiny Navigator connects everything from 'your ultimate self' to 'today's to-do' in 11 steps.
The AI fills them in from top to bottom. No need to do it all at once.

━━ The 11-Step Structure ━━

Ultimate Self → 10 Years → 5 Years → 3 Years → 1 Year → 6 Months → 3 Months → 1 Month → 2 Weeks → 1 Week → Today

━━ Real Example: Day 1 Conversation ━━

AI: "What do you ultimately want to become in life?"
You: "Someone who's financially free"
AI: "Love it! So what would that look like 10 years from now, specifically?"
You: "Earning at least $10K a month?"
AI: "Got it! And where would you be at the 5-year mark?"
You: "Hmm... maybe $5K a month?"
→ Naturally fills in from top to bottom like this

━━ Real Example: Day 3 Conversation ━━

AI: "Your ultimate goal is 'financial freedom' and 5-year target is '$5K/month income,' right? What about 3 years from now?"
You: "Maybe earning $2K/month from a side hustle?"
AI: "Nice! Should I save that?"
→ Fill in 1-2 steps a day and you'll finish in about a week

━━ Case: Yesterday's Goal Check ━━

Every morning, the AI checks yesterday's goal:
AI: "Yesterday's goal was '30 minutes of exercise' — did you do it?"
- If yes → Praise + moves to today's planning
- If no → Asks why + suggests adjustments

Bottom line: You don't have to fill anything in manually. Just talk to the AI and it fills everything in for you.
destiny.source: AI-powered reverse goal setting — break down the big picture into today's action steps

taskBoard.title: Task Board
taskBoard.subtitle: Track your work at a glance
taskBoard.description:
The Task Board manages your to-dos in 3 stages:

⬜ Not Started → 🔵 In Progress → ✅ Done

It all flows naturally through your conversations with the AI.

━━ Case 1: Creating a Task ━━

You: "I need to write a report this week"
AI: "Should I add 'write report' as a task?"
You: "Yes"
→ Task created with 'Not Started' status

━━ Case 2: Status Update ━━

During morning chat:
AI: "You have 'write report' in Not Started — starting it today?"
You: "Yeah, I'm on it today"
→ Automatically changed to 'In Progress'

━━ Case 3: Completing a Task ━━

During evening chat:
AI: "How's 'write report' going? It was in progress."
You: "All done!"
AI: "Congrats! Should I mark it complete?"
You: "Yes"
→ ✅ Marked complete + auto-logged to Destiny Navigator as today's achievement

━━ Key Points ━━

1. Task completion = auto-recorded in Destiny Navigator
   Finished tasks are logged as that day's accomplishments

2. AI checks in daily
   Morning: "Any 'Not Started' tasks you want to tackle today?"
   Evening: "How far did you get on your 'In Progress' tasks?"

3. No manual clicks needed
   Create, update, and complete tasks entirely through conversation
taskBoard.source: AI-integrated task management — create through chat, auto-log to Destiny Navigator on completion

epistle.title: Self Epistle
epistle.subtitle: Organize your day through conversation
epistle.description:
Self Epistle is a system that records your daily gratitude, important events, and reflections.
It gets filled in automatically through your evening chat with the AI.

━━ Structure ━━

[To Yesterday's Me]
- 3 things you're grateful for
- 3 important things that happened
- 1 thing that made you angry
- 3 leisure activities

[To Tomorrow's Me]
- 3 reflections

━━ Real Example: AI Fills It In For You ━━

AI: "How was your day?"
You: "Pretty busy, but not bad. A coworker bought me coffee, which was nice"
AI: "Oh nice! Should I save 'coworker buying you coffee' as something you're grateful for?"
You: "Sure"
→ Auto-saved to gratitude section

AI: "What was the most important thing today?"
You: "We had the kickoff meeting for the new project"
→ Auto-saved to important events

AI: "Anything that frustrated you today?"
You: "Ugh, my package got lost again"
→ Auto-saved to anger section

AI: "Looking back on today, what could you have done better?"
You: "I should've prepped more for the meeting"
→ Auto-saved to reflections

━━ The Key ━━

You're not manually filling out a form.
Just chat with the AI like you're talking to a friend.
The AI pulls out the gratitude, important events, frustrations, and reflections from your conversation and organizes them automatically.

Only today and yesterday are writable. Emotions get distorted fast, so recording them on the same day is what matters.
epistle.source: AI auto-extraction — automatically categorizes gratitude/reflections from your conversation

discipline.title: Discipline Mastery
discipline.subtitle: Check your daily rules
discipline.description:
Discipline Mastery is a system for checking off rules you've committed to following every day.

━━ How to Set Up ━━

1. Add rules on the Discipline Mastery page
2. Check off the rules you followed each day

━━ Example Rules ━━

- Wake up by 7 AM
- Drink 2L of water
- Exercise 30 minutes
- Less than 1 hour of social media
- In bed by 10 PM
- Write in gratitude journal (→ auto-linked to Self Epistle)

━━ AI Integration ━━

Tell the AI and it adds rules for you:

You: "Add a morning stretching rule for me"
AI: "Should I add 'morning stretching' as a discipline?"
You: "Yes"
→ Automatically added to your discipline list

The AI reminds you in the morning:
AI: "You've got 5 disciplines registered — let's crush it today!"

━━ Tips ━━

- Start with just 3 rules
- 2 easy ones + 1 slightly challenging one
- Once you hit 90% for 2 weeks straight, add one more
- The goal isn't perfection — it's consistency
discipline.source: Habit check system — AI reminds you daily and lets you add rules through conversation

success.title: Success Code (100 Days)
success.subtitle: Stay consistent for 100 days
success.description:
A system for recording one goal every day for 100 days.

━━ How to Start ━━

1. Go to Success Code and create a 'New Project'
2. Set a topic to track daily for 100 days
3. Log a quick entry each day

━━ Project Ideas ━━

- 100 Days of Reading: Read at least 30 minutes daily
- 100 Days of Exercise: Log your workout every day
- 100 Days of Coding: Write at least 1 line of code daily
- 100 Days of Drawing: One sketch per day
- 100 Days of English: Record your study session daily

━━ Case Study: 100 Days of Reading ━━

Day 1: "Started 'Atomic Habits.' Read chapter 1."
Day 15: "Getting into a groove. 20 pages a day now."
Day 45: "It's a habit. Feels weird not to read."
Day 78: "Starting my fifth book."
Day 100: "Finished 6 books in 100 days!"

━━ AI Integration ━━

Just tell the AI and it creates the project for you:
You: "I want to start a 100-day exercise project"
AI: "Should I create a '100 Days of Exercise' project?"
→ Auto-created

━━ The Key ━━

Missing a day is fine.
What matters is showing up again the next day.
It's not about perfection — it's about consistency.
success.source: 100-day habit formation system — AI checks your progress daily

money.title: Money Flow
money.subtitle: Record spending through conversation
money.description:
Money Flow is a ledger for tracking your income and expenses.
It gets recorded naturally through your conversations with the AI.

━━ Real Example: Auto-Logged During Evening Chat ━━

AI: "Did you spend any money today?"
You: "Had a sandwich for lunch, $9. Grabbed a coffee too, $5."
AI: "Should I log sandwich $9 (food) and coffee $5 (food)?"
You: "Yes"
→ Expenses auto-logged with categories

━━ Real Example: Recording Income ━━

You: "Got my paycheck this month, $3,500"
AI: "Should I log $3,500 as salary income?"
→ Income auto-recorded

━━ Tips ━━

1. Easiest if you do it during your evening report
2. The AI asks "Did you spend any money today?"
3. Even rough descriptions work — the AI sorts out amounts and categories
4. Check monthly stats on the Money Flow page

━━ The Key ━━

You're not manually punching numbers into a budgeting app.
Just tell the AI "Had pizza for $15 today" and you're done.
money.source: AI conversational ledger — just say it and it's auto-categorized and recorded
